body:
## Deliverable

The pack's `no-comments` regains what the ESLint-baseline adaptation dropped from pstack's version.

Lives in this repo (`the-metafactory/soma-pstack`).

## Settled by

Principal, 2026-10-25: file nodes for the skill gaps from the pstack skills deep check (finding S7, Algorithm run `pstack-principles-deep-check-2026-10-25`).

## Acceptance criteria

- An independent reviewer subagent checks each slice's removals before the PR.
- A comment that says "do not remove" gets a /how or /why check before it is kept or removed.
- A fix that needs a new shape routes to the architect step instead of a comment.
- the-metafactory/soma#1068's member list stops calling no-comments "ported" until this lands.

Live probe: one no-comments slice on a scratch branch shows the reviewer's verdict and one how/why-checked comment.

## Touches

the no-comments skill.

## Out of scope

- Other findings from the same deep check (sibling nodes).

Moved from the-metafactory/soma#1087.
